name: Component Packaging
old_description: Combine specified parts and quantities into accurate, ready-to-use kits with the packaging and labels your program requires.
about:
Component Packaging operates from an approximately 30,000-square-foot facility in Joplin, Missouri. The company was purchased in 2006 by Mike and Lori Magoulas, who brought more than 15 years of packaging industry experience to build a specialized service around fastener kitting, assembly, and inspection. Their son, Nick Magoulas, joined after military service and a management career at a Fortune 500 automotive firm, and now helps lead the business as a generational, family-owned operation.

The company provides fastener and component packaging services including kitting, nut-and-bolt assembly, master-kit creation, quality inspection for rust, mixed parts, thread defects, and contamination, as well as sorting, rework, relabeling, and repackaging. Additional capabilities cover receiving and storage, boxing and box-down work, heat-shrink sleeving, piecework, and hand packaging for jobs that don’t fit automated runs. The facility processes up to 680,000 parts per day using a mix of automated equipment and skilled manual labor.

Component Packaging primarily serves fastener distributors and industrial customers across 36 states, helping them add packaging capacity without investing in equipment or staff. Distributors send customer-owned inventory for custom kits, assembly, inspection, or rework, and the company coordinates shipping from its central location near major interstate routes.

The company emphasizes direct accountability—customers reach an owner or manager when exceptions arise—and a “whatever it takes” mindset that matches the method to the job, whether automated for repeatable volume or hand-packaged for complex combinations.

name: Congregation Apparel
old_description: As a team of dedicated designers and artisans, we aim to provide quality screen printing and embroidery, while inspiring communities to come together and create!
about:
Congregation Apparel operates from Pewaukee, Wisconsin, where founders Jordan and Kelsey Shimon run the business as a family-owned venture. The couple, who also serve as youth pastors in Corpus Christi, Texas, started the company out of a shared passion for clothing as a means of building community. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the brand emphasizes its Midwestern roots and a mission to gather people through custom apparel.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery for custom garments, offering a full design-to-delivery workflow that includes digital mock‑ups for client approval, vector artwork conversion, and an optional online pop‑up storefront with a dedicated URL for selling gear. Production runs start at 24 pieces per design, with samples available for orders of 100 or more. Turnaround typically falls between 14 and 21 business days, though rush requests can be accommodated.

Clients range from schools and sports teams to churches, businesses, and community groups across the United States. The company services southeastern Wisconsin and south Texas in person, while handling national orders remotely by phone and email. Wholesale brand selection is curated by the owners, who leverage deep catalog knowledge to match fabrics and styles to each project.

The Shimon’s frame their work as stewardship—turning raw materials into wearable expressions of identity and unity. They cite quality, creativity, and community as the pillars that differentiate their service, aiming to make the ordering process collaborative rather than transactional.

name: Connect Interiors
old_description: Join us on Tuesday, August 11, from 1:00–4:00 PM for an afternoon of connection, inspiration, and celebration as we open the doors to our new office and showroom.
about:
Based in Fargo, North Dakota, Connect Interiors operates as an office furniture dealer serving clients across North Dakota and Minnesota. The company maintains a showroom and warehouse facility in Fargo with a staff of approximately 10 employees.

Connect Interiors provides turnkey workplace solutions through a single point of contact, covering the full lifecycle from exploration and strategy through planning, design, implementation, and ongoing management. Services include workplace discovery, budgeting, 3D space planning using CET Designer, product specification, financing and leasing options, warehouse receiving, delivery, installation, move management, reconfiguration, and onsite maintenance. The firm integrates furniture, audiovisual, and architectural systems for corporate, healthcare, education, government, and hospitality environments.

The company serves corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, government agencies, and hospitality venues. Its approach emphasizes maximizing existing assets as well as planning new spaces, with a portfolio that includes Steelcase products and a curated ancillary collection of lounge seating, tables, lighting, and accessories from global designers.

Connect Interiors positions its value on a structured four-phase methodology—Explore & Strategy, Plan & Design, Provide & Implementation, and Manage & Support—aimed at reducing real estate utilization costs, furniture acquisition expenses, and maintenance overhead while addressing social and environmental factors.

old_description: Electronic wire and cable are available in a huge range of styles to meet specific application needs, with various combinations of stranding, insulation materials.
about:
Consolidated Electronic Wire & Cable, known online as Conwire, operates from Franklin Park, Illinois, where it manufactures standard and custom electronic wire and cable products. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in available sources.

The product line spans electronic wire and cable in numerous configurations — including category and LAN cables, extruded flat cable, coax, fire alarm cable, hook-up and lead wire, magnet wire, multi-conductor and multi-pair constructions, parallel cord and speaker wire, portable cord and power cable, power limited tray cable, tinned copper braid, and uninsulated wire. Beyond bulk cable, the company produces power cords and retractile cords designed for domestic and international standards, molded cable assemblies in customized styles, and cable and wiring harnesses assembled to customer specifications. A capabilities guide and several technical eBooks support custom project development.

The company serves customers with electronic applications across the United States and abroad, positioning its offerings to simplify supply chain processes for buyers of wire, cable, and assembled interconnect solutions.

name: Consolidated Wiring, LLC
old_description: With over 20 years of experience in the telecommunications industry, Consolidated Wiring, LLC prides itself in offering quality services for its clients.
about:
Consolidated Wiring, LLC was founded in 2006 in Huntsville, Alabama. The company entered the telecommunications market as a service provider and has expanded its offerings alongside the industry's shift toward fiber-based infrastructure.

Today the firm delivers a full suite of outside-plant and network services. Its construction crews handle aerial work such as pole transfers, make-ready arrangements, and small-cell installation, as well as underground operations including directional boring, trenching, and plowing. Fiber optic capabilities cover fusion splicing, testing, certification, and troubleshooting, along with micro-duct installation and FTTX/FTTH deployment. The company also provides WAN/LAN cabling, wireless network installation, 24/7 emergency response for storm and disaster recovery, MDU/MTU wiring for residential and commercial buildings, and end-to-end project management from design through activation and closeout.

Consolidated Wiring serves telecommunications carriers, cable television operators, fiber-to-the-home builders, and commercial and residential property developers. Municipal and utility clients also rely on its rapid mobilization for disaster restoration.

The company cites its more than 20 years of telecommunications experience and a stated focus on quality customer satisfaction as the core differentiators that have guided its growth.

The store carries both FR clothing and general safety supplies under one roof, providing a single source for items such as welding caps, hard hats, and safety glasses.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and operation as a point of distinction for customers seeking a nearby source for safety gear.

about:
Contract Manufacturing NE (CMNE) operates a full-service food manufacturing facility in Bristol, Connecticut. The company provides end-to-end manufacturing, packaging, and logistics services for food brands, guiding products from concept through to the consumer.

CMNE's capabilities span research and development for formulation refinement and shelf-life improvement, co-manufacturing and co-packing tailored to specific volumes and formats, private labeling that includes ingredient sourcing and packaging design, as well as secure warehousing, order fulfillment, and shipping logistics. The facility is structured to support scalable production runs for clients ranging from early-stage startups to established brands.

The company serves food brands and product developers seeking a single-source partner for the entire supply chain. Its customer base includes emerging brands launching their first product and established companies expanding their product lines, all within the food manufacturing sector.

CMNE highlights four core differentiators: end-to-end support with manufacturing, packaging, storage, and shipping under one roof; scalable solutions built for any brand stage; a quality-driven commitment to consistency, safety, and regulatory compliance; and a brand-focused philosophy that ties the company's success directly to its clients' growth.

name: Contract Medical Manufacturing LLC
old_description: We take pride in our best in class manufacturing capabilities, our quality driven business model, and our customer focused service.
about:
Contract Medical Manufacturing (CMM) operates from Oxford, Connecticut, just off Interstate 84 between Boston and New York City. The company was formed in 2007 as a spin-off of Doctors Research Group, Inc., with roots tracing back to 2000. Richard Deslauriers, a mechanical engineer and physician who previously worked at Johnson & Johnson and Medtronic, established CMM to provide full-service contract manufacturing for the medical device market.

CMM specializes in mechanical and electromechanical assembly of Class I and Class II sterile and non-sterile medical devices. Its capabilities extend beyond assembly to include supply chain management, supplier qualification, inventory control, process development and validation, statistical analysis, device testing, packaging, labeling, and coordination of third-party sterilization. The facility houses precision machining equipment such as an Okuma MX45VAE vertical machining center (30×19×17.5 in, 20-tool magazine) and an Okuma CNC lathe with a 12-tool turret, enabling in-house component production. The company operates under FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485:2016 quality systems.

CMM serves medical device companies ranging from Fortune 100 corporations to early-stage startups, positioning itself as a co-development partner rather than a pure outsourcing vendor. Customers rely on CMM for single-source management of purchasing, incoming inspection, warehousing, assembly, testing, packaging, and distribution.

The company emphasizes a quality-driven culture built on over 100 years of combined management experience in medical device manufacturing, packaging, and design. Its differentiation lies in offering a complete outsourcing solution — from supplier identification through finished-goods distribution — while maintaining regulatory compliance and a problem-solving approach to streamlining production.
